evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide a mobile application for Android and iOS devices and present the initial access interface at app startup.

issues.detected_issue: provide a mobile application for Android and iOS devices and present the initial access interface
issues.explanation: The statement combines two distinct requirements: platform availability and startup interface presentation.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into: 1) The system shall provide a mobile application compatible with Android and iOS devices. 2) The system shall display the initial access interface when the user launches the mobile application.
